title: Raccoon wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <polygon points='22,42 14,18 36,30' fill='#7a8fa6'/>
  <polygon points='78,42 86,18 64,30' fill='#7a8fa6'/>
  <polygon points='24,38 19,24 33,31' fill='#c98fb5'/>
  <polygon points='76,38 81,24 67,31' fill='#c98fb5'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='34' ry='28' fill='#8ca3bd'/>
  <!-- Cheek fluff -->
  <polygon points='16,52 4,44 8,56 2,60 14,62' fill='#a9bdd4'/>
  <polygon points='84,52 96,44 92,56 98,60 86,62' fill='#a9bdd4'/>
  <!-- White face patches -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='56' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#d7e3ee'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='56' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#d7e3ee'/>
  <!-- Dark mask band -->
  <path d='M18,47 Q50,38 82,47 Q82,58 50,56 Q18,58 18,47 Z' fill='#3b4a5e'/>
  <!-- Sunglasses -->
  <rect x='25' y='43' width='21' height='13' rx='5' fill='#1f2a38'/>
  <rect x='54' y='43' width='21' height='13' rx='5' fill='#1f2a38'/>
  <rect x='46' y='46' width='8' height='4' rx='2' fill='#1f2a38'/>
  <rect x='28' y='45' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5fe0c8'/>
  <rect x='57' y='45' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5fe0c8'/>
  <rect x='23' y='43' width='4' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7a6fd8'/>
  <rect x='73' y='43' width='4' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#7a6fd8'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#2f3a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='2.5' ry='1.5' fill='#8ca3bd'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M44,69 Q50,74 56,69' stroke='#3b4a5e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='22' ry='17' fill='#8ca3bd'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#d7e3ee'/>
  <!-- Arms -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='83' rx='7' ry='11' fill='#7a8fa6' transform='rotate(18 26 83)'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='83' rx='7' ry='11' fill='#7a8fa6' transform='rotate(-18 74 83)'/>
  <!-- Tail stripes hint -->
  <path d='M72,92 Q84,86 82,74' stroke='#3b4a5e' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72,92 Q84,86 82,74' stroke='#8ca3bd' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
